pages.title: Document Classification
pages.purpose: Document classification: the Classification model, ClassificationResponse, classification strategies (consensus, higher-order, consensus-with-threshold), the classification tree, and vision-based classification flows.
instructions: Cite evidence for threshold range 1-10.
Explain Classification fields (name, description, contract, extraction_contract, image, extractor, uuid).
Explain Process.classify strategies CONSENSUS / HIGHER_ORDER / CONSENSUS_WITH_THRESHOLD and ClassificationTree level-by-level descent.
Explain text-only classification prompt and vision one-by-one image classification with reference images.

pages.title: Document Loaders
pages.purpose: Document the document-loader subsystem: the DocumentLoader ABC and CachedDocumentLoader caching layer, source/format detection, the standardized page-based output format, vision mode, per-loader config dataclasses, and every concrete loader.
instructions: Enumerate the concrete loaders with their SUPPORTED_FORMATS and config dataclasses (Tesseract, Azure, AWS Textract, Google Document AI, PyPdf, PdfPlumber, Spreadsheet, BeautifulSoup, MarkItDown, Docling, LLMImage, Txt, Doc2txt, Data, MistralOCR, EasyOCR).
Explain can_handle extension+MIME detection, TTLCache caching keyed on source+vision_mode, and set_vision_mode.
Loaders return a list of page dicts; each page carries 'content' text and, in vision mode, 'image' bytes; some loaders add tables/forms/formulas/barcodes/languages metadata.
Mention LoaderInterceptor extension seam.

pages.title: Evaluation Subsystem
pages.purpose: Document the extract_thinker.eval package: Evaluator and TeacherStudentEvaluator, datasets, field comparison types, metrics (precision/recall/F1), schema validation, hallucination detection, cost tracking, and the CLI.
instructions: Explain ComparisonType enum and FieldComparisonConfig.
Explain EvaluationDataset/FileSystemDataset validation (labels must match documents).
Explain Evaluator.evaluate producing EvaluationReport with field/document/schema/time metrics; skip_failures behavior.
Explain TeacherStudentEvaluator comparative report and HallucinationDetector (LLM vs HEURISTIC strategies).
Explain the CLI (--config JSON, load_contract, setup_extractor, --detect-hallucinations, --track-costs).

pages.title: Extraction Pipeline
pages.purpose: Document the Extractor: extract/classify/extract_batch entrypoints, the universal content format, vision mode setup, multi-source merging, completion strategies (FORBIDDEN/PAGINATE/CONCATENATE), interceptor hooks, and error handling.
instructions: Explain PaginationHandler (per-page parallel, optional-field model, merge with conflict resolution) and ConcatenationHandler (raw JSON continuation up to 3 retries).
Explain extract_batch and BatchJob OpenAI integration briefly, cross-referencing batch-processing content.
Explain the FORBIDDEN strategy and how IncompleteOutputException / ValidationError / JSONDecodeError become ExtractThinkerError; vision errors via is_vision_error/classify_vision_error.

Trace the extract() flow: dependency validation, vision handling, loader resolution (extension then capability), _map_to_universal_format, page-count to LLM, _extract -> _build_messages -> llm.request.

pages.title: LLM Integration
pages.purpose: Document the LLM class: the two backends (litellm+instructor and pydantic-ai), structured-output extraction, LiteLLM Router support, thinking/reasoning mode with token budgeting, dynamic prompt mode, and request/raw_completion flows.
instructions: Cite LLM.TIMEOUT=3000ms, DEFAULT_MAX_COMPLETION_TOKENS=8000, and token_limit override.
Describe LLMEngine.DEFAULT (instructor MD_JSON over litellm.completion) vs LLMEngine.PYDANTIC_AI.
Explain is_dynamic mode and build_dynamic_prompt/extract_thinking_json.
Explain set_thinking/set_page_count token budgeting (DEFAULT_PAGE_TOKENS, thinking budget = 1/3 content tokens, clamped by MIN/MAX_THINKING_BUDGET).

pages.title: Architecture Overview
pages.purpose: Explain the overall system: package layout, ownership boundaries between the public API, models, document loaders, LLM integration, and evaluation modules; core control/data flows and the shared page-based content format.
instructions: Cite concrete source evidence for flow claims.

Describe the layered architecture: DocumentLoaders produce a standard list-of-pages format, Extractor/Process orchestrate loaders and the LLM, LLM produces instructor-validated structured output against Contract (Pydantic) models.
Document ownership boundaries and the extension seams (new loaders, new LLM backends, new splitters, new completion handlers).

pages.title: Process Workflow and Splitting
pages.purpose: Document the Process orchestration class and splitter subsystem: loading files, classification layers, eager vs lazy splitting strategies, DocGroup/DocGroups aggregation, and per-group extraction.
instructions: Explain Splitter ABC and aggregate_doc_groups algorithm, ImageSplitter and TextSplitter fallback behavior.
Explain doc-groups models: DocGroup, DocGroups, DocGroups2, EagerDocGroup/DocGroupsEager.
Trace Process.load_file().split().extract(): loader resolution, at-least-2-page requirement, EAGER vs LAZY (paginate-capable PDF only), then per-DocGroup extract_async with set_skip_loading.

pages.title: Change Guide: Adding a Document Loader
pages.purpose: Focused change guide for adding a new DocumentLoader subclass to the library: required interface, config dataclass conventions, caching, vision mode, and export wiring, with test expectations.
instructions: Mention exporting from extract_thinker/__init__.py.
Reference the base loader tests and per-loader test file conventions.

Walk through the minimal contract: extend CachedDocumentLoader (or DocumentLoader), set SUPPORTED_FORMATS, implement load(source)->List[Dict] with 'content', add optional config dataclass, implement can_handle_vision.

pages.title: Change Guide: Debugging Extraction
pages.purpose: Focused change guide for diagnosing extraction failures: dependency validation, loader-resolution failures, vision errors, incomplete-output handling under the FORBIDDEN strategy, and the completion strategies that recover partial output.
instructions: Enumerate the failure modes evidenced in code: ValueError for missing loader/LLM, ValueError no suitable loader, InvalidVisionDocumentLoaderError, VisionError, ExtractThinkerError for incomplete output under FORBIDDEN.
Explain how to switch to PAGINATE or CONCATENATE completion strategies to recover from long-document truncation.
Reference test cases that assert these behaviors.

pages.title: Quickstart and Task Routing
pages.purpose: Practical quickstart for installing ExtractThinker and running the core document-intelligence tasks (extraction, classification, split-and-extract, batch, markdown conversion, evaluation), plus a routing map to the rest of the wiki.
instructions: ExtractThinker is a Python 3.9+ library; installation is `pip install extract_thinker`.
Ground every quickstart snippet in the actual public API exported from extract_thinker/__init__.py.
Map each common task to its wiki page (extraction, classification, splitting/process, batch, markdown, evaluation).
